claims.statement: Sessions are stored under the Pi agent directory (PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR or getAgentDir()/sessions); session-watcher.ts watches that tree and emits debounced sessions.changed events, invalidating the allowed roots cache on change.

session-index.ts fingerprints session files (size, mtimeMs, ctimeMs, ino) to avoid re-parsing unchanged files, and listAllSessions prefers the index, falling back to SessionManager.listAll() when it is unavailable.

File browsable roots are derived from every session's cwd and projectRoot plus ~/pi-cwd-* directories, cached with a watcher-aware TTL and generation counter so a stale async scan cannot restore old roots (file-access.ts, allowed-roots.ts).
Low-level path checks (isFilePathAllowed, canonical path, Windows absolute detection) live in file-access-core.ts and are enforced by every files.* handler.

resolveProject in src/shared/worktree.ts maps a cwd to a ProjectInfo (projectRoot, branch, isWorktree, isTopLevel) with a 60s cache invalidated on worktree add/remove; worktrees.list/create/remove and git.status implement the switcher and porcelain status.
Auto session titles are generated from the first user message by agent.generateTitle as a silent LLM request that never touches session history, sanitized and capped at AUTO_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH.
The skills service (src/agent-host/skills-service.ts) searches skills.sh and falls back to the skills.sh CLI via runNpx when the API fails; skills.install runs 'skills add' with --agent pi.
Package actions for plugins run in a bounded child worker (plugin-worker.ts/plugin-worker-client.ts, marker-framed base64 protocol, max 64KB, validated cwd/action) rather than in the Host process.
plugins-service.ts manages plugins.list and plugins.set with global or project scope and persists per-source enabled state plus a disabled-plugin backup file (pi-desktop-plugin-filters.json).
If the agent session dir cannot be created or the watcher cannot start, startSessionWatcher becomes a no-op and the app relies on the fallback SessionManager path and watcher-aware roots TTL.
